import json, subprocess, sys, random

rng = random.Random(4242)
def run(reqs):
    payload = b"".join((json.dumps(r) + "\n").encode() for r in reqs)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]

out = run([req])[0]

# maximum nodes (256) with maximum args (32) and 10 atoms
def bushy(total):
    if total == 1: return {"op": "true"}
    kids = total - 1
    n = min(32, kids)
    sizes = [1] * n
    left = kids - n
    i = 0
    while left > 0:
        j = i % n
        if sizes[j] == 1: sizes[j] = 2; left -= 1
        elif sizes[j] < 32: sizes[j] += 1; left -= 1
        i += 1
    return {"op": "and", "args": [bushy(sz) if sz > 1 else {"op": "true"} for sz in sizes]}
